verdict.rationale: Unleash's pricing page advertises export/import of feature flags for easy migration. The Admin API is described as giving comprehensive programmatic access to all resources, which allows scripted extraction. Self-hostable open source deployment via Docker further reduces lock-in. However, the documented export covers only feature flags, and no evidence names the export format or confirms a complete account-wide export. Missing for 10: documented full-data export covering all resource types (segments, strategies, users, audit logs), explicit open-format specification (e.g. JSON schema), first-party export docs beyond a pricing bullet, independent hands-on migration corroboration.
